name: thimble
description: thimble: notebook-backed analysis of agent runs inside a Claude Code session. One plugin, sourced from ./plugin of this tree; the version is plugin/.claude-plugin/plugin.json's.

plugins.name: thimble
plugins.description: Turns a Claude Code session into an analyst workbench over the agent transcripts in the working directory: the thimble MCP tools, seven hooks, the /thimble skill and the channel launcher. Needs the thimble server installed beside it (scripts/install.sh).
